title: SRUG: A Fusion-Driven Generator Network for Medical Image Translation
abstract: arXiv:2601.04785v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: MRI sequence synthesis aims to recover missing image contrast while preserving patient-specific anatomy. The choice of generation mechanism affects both optimization and the way source information reaches the synthesized image. In this study, we propose SRUG, a supervised standalone fusion-driven generator that learns a deterministic source-to-target mapping for paired MRI synthesis. Its direct reconstruction formulation removes generator-discriminator competition and requires neither variational latent sampling nor iterative diffusion denoising. To support structural fidelity within this formulation, SRUG uses a residual encoder adapted for image reconstruction, with a full-resolution convolutional stem, pooling-separated feature stages, and channel recalibration embedded in the residual branches. translated_abstract: MRI序列合成旨在恢复缺失的图像对比度，同时保留患者特异性的解剖结构。生成机制的选择既影响优化过程，也影响源信息传递到合成图像的方式。在本研究中，我们提出了SRUG，一种有监督的独立融合驱动生成器，它为成对MRI合成学习确定性的源到目标映射。其直接重建的公式化设计消除了生成器与判别器之间的竞争，既不需要变分潜变量采样，也不需要迭代式的扩散去噪。为了在该框架下支持结构保真度，SRUG采用了一种适用于图像重建的残差编码器，包含全分辨率卷积主干、由池化分隔的多级特征阶段，以及嵌入在残差分支中的通道重校准模块。嵌套多尺度解码器（NMD）反复融合所得到的空间特征，并通过单一……预测目标序列（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种融合驱动的有监督生成器网络SRUG，通过直接重建的确定性源到目标映射实现成对MRI序列合成，无需生成对抗竞争、变分采样或扩散去噪，并借助残差编码器与嵌套多尺度解码器保持解剖结构保真度。
en_tdlr: SRUG is a supervised fusion-driven generator that performs paired MRI synthesis via direct deterministic source-to-target reconstruction, eliminating the need for GAN competition, variational latent sampling, or iterative diffusion denoising, while a reconstruction-adapted residual encoder and a nested multi-scale decoder preserve structural fidelity.
